mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in unemployment rate above 5.2% triggers a negative market reaction as it signals weakening labor market conditions, causing S&P 500 to decline over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals weak consumer demand, causing S&P 500 to fall over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High growth in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 upward over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS growth is above 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPI inflation above 2.5% triggers a negative market reaction as it signals potential monetary tightening, causing S&P 500 to decline over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and decline in the federal funds rate signals a policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%), S&P 500 tends to rise over the next 20 trading days due to strong labor market conditions supporting consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
